classification.difficultyReason: Rewrite numerical multipliers and divisors using two prime bases, then determine missing exponents, including a negative exponent.

content.prompt: Fill in the empty boxes to make the expressions equal.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Make each surrounding expression equal to $2^5\times3^4$.

spec.description: Central expression with eight outward curved arrows and two outlined superscript response boxes on each surrounding expression. Four branches lie on each side.
spec.mathematics: Each surrounding expression must equal 2^5 times 3^4. Branch order clockwise from top left: divide by 32; multiply by 12, 18, 72, 108; divide by 54, 24; multiply by 3/8.
spec.answerVisibility: The central expression, operations and numerical factors are permanent givens. All sixteen exponent boxes are blank; supplied blue answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Write each numerical factor using bases 2 and 3. Clockwise from top left:
$$\begin{align*}
2^{10}\times3^4\div32&=2^{10-5}\times3^4=2^5\times3^4\\
2^3\times3^3\times12&=2^{3+2}\times3^{3+1}=2^5\times3^4\\
2^4\times3^2\times18&=2^{4+1}\times3^{2+2}=2^5\times3^4\\
2^2\times3^2\times72&=2^{2+3}\times3^{2+2}=2^5\times3^4\\
2^3\times3^1\times108&=2^{3+2}\times3^{1+3}=2^5\times3^4\\
2^6\times3^7\div54&=2^{6-1}\times3^{7-3}=2^5\times3^4\\
2^8\times3^5\div24&=2^{8-3}\times3^{5-1}=2^5\times3^4\\
2^8\times3^3\times\frac38&=2^{8-3}\times3^{3+1}=2^5\times3^4
\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Make each surrounding expression equal to $2^7\times5^5$.

spec.description: Central expression with eight outward curved arrows, in the same arrangement as part a. Every branch has two outlined superscript boxes sized for two-digit or signed exponent responses.
spec.mathematics: Each surrounding expression must equal 2^7 times 5^5. Branch order clockwise from top left: divide by 50; multiply by 100, 160, 1000, 1280; divide by 1250, 10,000; multiply by 5/8.
spec.answerVisibility: The central expression, operations and numerical factors are permanent givens. All sixteen exponent boxes are blank; supplied blue answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Write each numerical factor using bases 2 and 5. Clockwise from top left:
$$\begin{align*}
2^8\times5^7\div50&=2^{8-1}\times5^{7-2}=2^7\times5^5\\
2^5\times5^3\times100&=2^{5+2}\times5^{3+2}=2^7\times5^5\\
2^2\times5^4\times160&=2^{2+5}\times5^{4+1}=2^7\times5^5\\
2^4\times5^2\times1000&=2^{4+3}\times5^{2+3}=2^7\times5^5\\
2^{-1}\times5^4\times1280&=2^{-1+8}\times5^{4+1}=2^7\times5^5\\
2^8\times5^9\div1250&=2^{8-1}\times5^{9-4}=2^7\times5^5\\
2^{11}\times5^9\div10{,}000&=2^{11-4}\times5^{9-4}=2^7\times5^5\\
2^{10}\times5^4\times\frac58&=2^{10-3}\times5^{4+1}=2^7\times5^5
\end{align*}$$
